children: Nektar Therapeutics won a $90 million jury verdict finding Eli Lilly breached the implied covenant under their rezpegaldesleukin license agreement.
Jury in Northern District of California found Lilly breached the implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing.
Jury awarded Nektar Therapeutics $90 million in damages; interest to be determined by the court.
Verdict follows a jury trial that began Sept. 8, 2026; post-trial proceedings and potential appeal remain possible.
